name: The world
source: OpenStreetMap land polygons via geo-maps earth-lands-100m 0.6.0 (npm @geo-maps/earth-lands-100m, about 100 m accuracy). Map data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0, openstreetmap.org/copyright. Package code MIT.
licence: ODbL 1.0 (derived database: the world raster, graph and land are ODbL too)

canal.note: Panama Canal abstraction: a straight two-cell navigable channel between the UN/LOCODE positions of Colon (PA ONX) and Panama City (PA PTY), not the canal's geometry. UN/LOCODE: UNECE.

crs: WGS 84 longitude/latitude (EPSG:4326); raster in Mercator rows aligned to the European chart
processing: 4x4 subsamples per cell; land if any subsample is land, approach-only if land covers at most half the cell; holes filled; latitudes -72..80; drawn land simplified 0.050 deg (overview) and 0.020 deg (regional). Not for navigation.
